description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarpdfSmarty, a helper class extending Sugarpdf for generating PDFs using Smarty templates within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It includes class properties, methods for setup and rendering, and references to external dependencies such as Sugar_Smarty and parent classes.

classes.name: SugarpdfSmarty
classes.description: A helper class for generating PDFs using Smarty templates, extending the Sugarpdf class, and providing custom pre-display setup and HTML rendering functionalities.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to disable header/footer printing and initialize the Smarty instance.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and outputs the PDF document, rendering the Smarty template if specified.

methods.name: _initSmartyInstance
methods.description: Initializes the Sugar_Smarty object if not already instantiated.
